children: , has officially returned to work on the project's source code.

One of the clearest indicators of the event's significance for the industry was the endorsement of Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz. Schwartz, who has stepped away from active development, briefly commented on his colleague's return on X.

There are good reasons for such an emotional gesture from the blockchain's co-creator. Schwartz previously said publicly that the only thing that could make him interrupt his own break and return to coding would be the chance to work alongside Bougalis again.
"I'm back, baby" What exactly is Bougalis rewriting in the ledger, and why is it needed?
Bougalis marked his return in the code itself by opening pull request PR #8300 in the official XRPLF/rippled repository, under the tongue-in-cheek title "I'm back, baby."

image.alt: Screenshot of a GitHub pull request titled Im back baby by user nbougalis in the XRPLF rippled repository detailing changes to BaseUInt.

children: This is more than a symbolic return. It is a deep, low-level modernization of the network's core. Bougalis's proposed changes aim to significantly improve security and optimize the ledger's performance:
BaseUInt refactoring: Moving foundational data types to use 64-bit elements wherever the architecture allows.
Addressing vulnerabilities: Removing unsafe raw pointers and unchecked runtime constructors entirely.
Result for the ecosystem: Improving code safety at compile time, which directly helps protect the network from failures under critical loads.

Nik Bougalis is a Ripple veteran, the company's eighth employee, and the author of key cryptographic patents for the platform. He left the project in 2022 and served as CTO of the Algorand Foundation in 2025. His return to XRPL coincides with sweeping structural changes across the industry.
H. Ayo Akinyele, head of engineering at RippleX, has already confirmed that Bougalis has been brought in to tackle ambitious next-generation technology challenges.

As real-world assets (RWA) are integrated into XRPL and the U.S. regulatory landscape continues to change, the return of a specialist of his caliber restores the ecosystem's main advantage: a strong, proven engineering tradition.

title: Ripple Pioneer Approves: Nik Bougalis Returns to Rewrite XRP Ledger Core
